messages.subject: Re: Combining faceting and text annotation
parts:
Hi Geoff,

Things will be easier if you get in the habit of only putting common
mappings in the ggplot() call, like this:

ggplot(aes(x,y),data=df)+
facet_grid(.~v)+
geom_line(aes(color=load)) +
geom_text(aes(x,y,label=lab),
data=data.frame(
x=2,y=3,v=c("A","B"),
lab=c("xxxx","YYY")))

Best,
Ista

On Tue, Mar 26, 2013 at 1:22 AM, Geoff Russell
<geoffrey...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> I'm just trying to understand labelling facets using geom_text
>
> Here's a sample;
>
> df=data.frame(x=c(1,2,3,4,5),y=c(2,3,2,4,7),load=c("X","Y","X","Y","X"),v=c("A","B","A","B","A"));
> p=ggplot(aes(x,y,color=load),data=df)+facet_grid(.~v)+geom_line();
> p=p+geom_text(aes(x,y,label=lab),data=data.frame(load=c("X","Y"),x=2,y=3,v=c("A","B"),lab=c("xxxx","YYY"),color=c("X")))
>
> It kind of works, but how do I get rid of the 'a's it puts in the legend and
> also
> get black text?
>
> Many thanks,
>
>
> Cheers,
> Geoff Russell
